KV cache transfer involves transferring the key-value pairs (KVs) between the model and the GPU. If the transfer is too slow, it can lead to increased latency and reduced performance. So, optimizing the KV cache transfer is important to maintain performance.

GPU scheduling refers to how the GPU resources are allocated to different parts of the model. If the GPU is not properly scheduled, it can lead to overutilization or underutilization, affecting the overall performance. Therefore, optimizing GPU scheduling is essential.
